newsitem.title: ITALY: Eni recovers after sell order knocks price.
newsitem.headline: Eni recovers after sell order knocks price.

text.p: Italian state-controlled energy group Eni fell 9.56 percent at the Milan stock market opening before being suspended briefly and then resuming trade.
Once trade resumed Eni shares were trading 0.75 percent down at 8450 lire. Traders said a sell order at the opening failed to meet corresponding buyers, forcing the price limit down.
"A brokerage put in a best price sale order on Eni, there was little on the book and the share price slumped," one broker said.
The bourse was generally lower. The all-share Mibtel index was posting a 0.74 percent fall to 11841 by 0930 GMT.
